browser_search.completion: Owned gsea reply with valid COUNT <= requested limit, all rows installed and original manager request completed. Page size 1..200. SEARCHING disallows reads/joins. Timeout or malformed reply closes session.
browser_search.selected_join: Re-read selected index, require matching ID/name, 2..6 player limits, occupied but non-full game and no ACTIVE flag. Confirm returned ID before IN_GAME; close session on mismatch.
browser_search.limits: Selected-row join guards tested with fixtures only; live tests join owned private games by name. Public joining, VR browser UI and full race lifecycle remain unverified.

shared_race_handoff.entry: Stable frontend, empty NetGame, owned PLAY_READY roster with 2..6 players, unique names/local player, matching original peer count and host role, connected selected logical pad.
shared_race_handoff.return: Queue original 0x18b1f0 only when no unrelated transition is pending; wait for stable frontend and no world/local player before stopping/resetting. Verify player disposal before restoring the previous empty NetGame. Conditional profile-state rollback.
shared_race_handoff.play_lifetime: Owned lobby disposes original PLAY connections if closed before handoff. After successful lobby release the race owns their cleanup, including failed initialization.
shared_race_handoff.limits: Bounded driving/return only. Six-player behavior, full race finish/results, browser interoperability, player-facing menu and headset race sight test remain unverified.

player_browser.entry: Root main menu: X, VR Settings, Online Profiles, BROWSE RACES. UI_Main.fng required in active list; GarageMain, Chyron_FE and MC_Background decorations allowed; all other packages, cycles and unreadable lists denied.
player_browser.ownership: Copied mutex mailbox with session epochs; Close overrides pending Open/Search. Only guest main-loop calls retail code. Root menu loss closes the browser. Live queue waiting does not expire as a failed handshake.

review_build.change_after_runtime_validation: Keep a live server queue waiting past handshake timeout. Targeted controller tests pass on Windows and Quest ARM64.

player_browser.limits: Read-only race browser. Headset panel/input acceptance pending. Create/join/ready/start, complete results and browser-game race interoperability remain open.

network_track_catalog.status: Read-only catalog helper and rule bounds tested on Windows and ARM64; production creation UI and settings ownership remain pending.
network_track_catalog.rules: All network tracks independent of career unlocks; six players except drag (four, or three on 4402). Sprint/drag/downhill drift one lap; circuit/URL/other drift 2..10; Street X 4..10. Data labels remain debug-only, not localized UI names.

vehicle_memory.status: Default-enabled on PCVR/Quest: 128 MB independent physical window, bounded 16..48 MB Cars extension, 64 rides. Local two-car churn passed. User confirms Quest local body retained; persistent city Loading screen reported. Missing regional assets and track-stream scheduling addressed in follow-up, live result pending.
vehicle_memory.bounded_extra: Up to three 16 MB physical blocks, held for process lifetime; no destructive phase-1 fallback after activation.

track_streaming.policy: New remote constructors and look loads wait for both original systems to be idle. Existing loads, poses and retirements continue. No timeout overrides the track state.
track_streaming.status: Original code compared; scheduling tests passed Windows and ARM64; live verification pending.

vehicle_files.hash: Unsigned 32-bit multiply by 33 plus uppercase path byte; initial 0xffffffff; CARS\TYPE\FILE.BIN
vehicle_files.bounds: At most 65536 sorted records, archive indices 0..9, sector*2048+bytes within existing ZZDATA file. Geometry, textures and vinyls required; corresponding nonempty loose files accepted.
vehicle_files.evidence: Owned US Xbox archive has 1362 records, all ranges valid. PEUGOT/COROLLA/SKYLINE available; PEUGOT106 and CORSA absent despite type-table records. Two actual Quest runs request absent PEUGOT106 files and then stop loading remote cars.
vehicle_files.limitation: Presence check does not convert or validate arbitrary mod formats. Regional cars use an explicit stock fallback pending compatible native assets.

private_paint_layout.supported_template: US Xbox one-mip P8; palette 1024 bytes; copied independent pixels/palette; original sources unchanged
private_paint_layout.slots: 7..12, bounded process-lifetime storage; prepare all three before publication; 18 owned contiguous physical allocations independent of the small general game heap
private_paint_layout.runtime_status: General-heap variant withheld after repeat allocation failures. Dedicated physical storage passed six-car/eight-native-model run: 1542 six-car ready frames. Final repeat with bounded P8 Vulkan hashing passed 1568 six-car ready frames, zero failures, retirement and player's 26 textures retained. Evidence: build/xyz-session-qa/skin-bounded-validation.json. PCVR installed/restarted 23:02:45 after user closed the previous session; public acceptance pending. Quest deferred by user.

race_settings_boundary.status: Windows unit tests and real-service original-engine create/read/leave for all six native race types passed; exact 0x4c profile restored. Quest source builds; hardware deferred.
race_settings_boundary.evidence: Original 0x164be0 reads a 13-byte password and copies it to both 0x41c35c and 0x41c369; 0x103c70 independently writes/compares those fields. Create 0x198230 consumes the same settings. Per-field conditional restoration preserves unrelated or subsequently changed profile values.

track_name_boundary.status: Windows fixtures and actual loaded Xbox language labels for all six real-service race types passed, including reverse labels; headset UI check pending.
track_name_boundary.table: Sorted unsigned 32-bit hash, relocated guest string pointer; 8 bytes per entry. Original loader adds pool base to each string offset.

career_browser_boundary.status: Original pause/unload/browser/Explore handoff implemented and exercised with copied careers; original position, profile and TLS survive return. See the integration guide for full-race and headset validation.

cinematic_guard.reason: Wait for intro/outro/story sequences before accepting or draining a paused career transfer. A prematurely forced Pause left a career NIS repositioning the following race car through 3FC30 -> 1AE8C0 -> 1EC770 -> 1E5370.

career_browser_boundary.position_preservation: Original 0xc1b20 calls 0x120260 when mode=1; if race_type=0 it copies local car chassis position +0x60/64/68 into career +0x8750/54/58, heading +0x40c to career +0x8760, sets career +0x8744. No file save call in that path.
career_browser_boundary.controller: Original 0x119700 maps input bits 1/2/4/8 to logical controllers 0/1/2/3. Resume 0xafbd0 and explore handler 0xc7760 consume that bit mask. A zero-mask generic dispatch is insufficient for explore.

functions.role: Package event dispatch with zero input mask
